reason: Research was partial: five web searches returned mostly undated or older material, and I could not verify the 10-14 to 10-16 semiconductor selloff itself. What I could confirm: UNH (18%, the largest leg) reported a Q3 2026 adjusted EPS beat of $4.69 vs $4.14 consensus, raised FY adjusted EPS guidance to at least $20.50, and closed 10-14 up 4.7% at $395.62; average analyst target is about $480. Staples and healthcare legs (PG, KO, PFE, NEE, XLE) are up 4.6% to 9.2% and are not in the semiconductor selloff path. The ASML leg is -11.74%, but a dated-unclear Barchart item reports Q3 results on 10-14 with FY26 guidance raised to EUR 43-45B. Cutting ASML into a possible sector rebound on an unclear read would be a discretionary bet I cannot justify with verified data. Book is 50% cash with a -2.67% max drawdown, and the defensive tilt is working. Holding. Limitation: this decision rests more on the packet marks than on verified current quotes.
